senses.gloss:
कुतप कु-तप् + अ, m. and n.
 1. A blanket made of the hair of the mountain goat, Man. 3, 234.
 2. The eighth portion of the day, about noon, MBh. 13, 6040.

कुतस् कुतस्, i. e. क + व + तस् (cf. किम् and कु), adv.
 1. = Abl. of किम्, Lass. 13, 14.
 2. From what place, Hiḍ. 2, 24.
 3. Whence, Rām. 1, 14, 36.
 4. Whither, Bhāg. P. 8, 19, 34.
 5. Why, Rām. 3, 1, 12.
 6. How, Brāhmaṇ. 1, 28.
 7. How much less? Indr. 1, 17.
 8. With following अपि, From some, Pañc. 229, 1; from somewhere.
 9. With न and following चन, From no quarter whatever, Man. 6, 40.
 10. With following चिद्, From any, Daśak. in Chr. 179, 7; from anywhere, Pañc. 239, 5.
 --Comp.
कुतुक कुतुक, n. Desire, Gīt. i. 42.

कुतूहल कुतूहल, n.
 1. Eagerness, Nal. 1, 16; abl. Eagerly.
 2. Curiosity, Nal. 13, 48.
 3. Desire, Lass. 67, 12.
 4. A surprising object, Pañc. 124, 9.
कुतूहलवन्त् कुतूहल + वन्त्, adj., f. वती, Anxious, eager, Mālav. 51, 7.

कुतूहलिन् कुतूहलिन्, i. e. कुतूहल + इन्, adj., f. नी.
 1. Eager, Ragh. 15, 65.
 2. Inquisitive, Man. 4, 63.

कुत्र कुत्र, i. e. क + व + त्र (cf. किम् and कु), adv.
 1. Where, Rām. 5, 34, 21.
 2. Whither, Lass. 25, 5.
 3. कुत्र--क्व are used to denote a great difference, Bhāg. P. 7, 9, 25.
 4. With following अपि, Somewhere, Mārk. P. 8, 120.
 5. With following चिद्,
 a. In some, Pañc. 256, 6.
 b. Somewhere, Rām. 5, 1, 5. With preceding न, Nowhere, MBh. 3, 10359; Pañc. 36, 22.
 c. कुत्र चिद्--कुत्र चिद्, In some cases--in others, Man. 9, 34.
 6. With preceding यत्र and following च, In whomsoever even, Bhāg. P. 8, 8, 22.
 --Cf. Goth. hvathro and hvar; Engl. whither; Lat. cur.
कुत्रत्य कुत्र + त्य, adj. Where dwelling, Bhāg. P. 5, 10, 17.

कुत्स् कुत्स्, i. 10 (rather a denom. [] derived from कुतस्), in epic poetry also i. 1, MBh. 2, 2298, Par.
 1. To blame, MBh. 2, 2121.
 2. To contemn, Man. 2, 54.
 कुत्सित, Contemptible, MBh. 13, 2222.
 कुत्स्य, Blameable, Bhartṛ. 2, 12 (thus to be read).
 --With the prep. अभि अभि, To blame. Rām. 2, 75, 2.
कुत्स कुत्स, m. The name of a Ṛṣi, Chr. 296, 3.
कुत्सा कुत्स् + आ, f. Blaming, MBh. 13, 6589; Blame, 2, 2235.
कुत्सन कुत्स् + अन, n. Contempt, Man. 4, 163.
कु-तन्त्री कु-तन्त्री, f. the tail, MBh. 12, 5355.
कु- + तर्क कु- + तर्क, and दुस्-, m. wrong reasoning, Bhāg. P. 5, 13, 22; 6, 9, 35.
कु- + तापस कु- + तापस, m. and f., सी, a wicked ascetic, Kathās. 13, 141.
कुतोनिमित्त कुतोनिमित्त, i. e. कुतस्-, adj. by what caused, Rām. 2, 74, 17.
